name: Bypass Ward (Combat)
body:
Your familiarity with magical protection allows you to bypass some of its effects.

Prerequisite(s): Disruptive or ability to cast dispel magic, base attack bonus +7

Benefit(s): When you attack a creature that is benefiting from an enhancement bonus to AC you may ignore an amount of that enhancement bonus equal to one quarter your base attack bonus, rounded down.
